about: dsl.expand -> plan.to_plan (kdt .25, fc 2) -> plan.frames -> liveliness.animate(seed) -> basis.synthesize (limits + shoulder clearance, no mujoco projection); limited = basis.limit_frames(actuator rows, 1/25 s), the robot's speed caps; see expressive/golden.py

cases.recipe: osc 3 a .5 1.2 E=2 | osc 2 z .4 .9 | osc 2 d .1 1.5 E=.2 | hold 1 E=0
go .3 p=.3 E=1 | osc 2 nod .3 .6 | osc 1.5 sway .3 .9 E=2 | osc 1.2 chatter .3 .4 | go .4 p=0 g=.15

errors.error: unknown channel 'q' (use a x z p k b d g E)
hold only changes energy (E=v); move with go: 'hold 1 p=.3'
osc period below 0.3 s: fast shaking belongs in E (energy), not osc
osc on unknown channel 'E' (use a x z p k b d g or nod bob sway lean turn chatter)
osc on unknown channel 'wiggle' (use a x z p k b d g or nod bob sway lean turn chatter)
osc needs: osc D ch amp period, got 'osc 2 p .3'
osc amplitude 3 too big for p (range -1..1)
osc only changes energy (E=v); move with go: 'osc 2 p .3 1 z=.5'
recipe lasts 31.0 s; keep it under 30 s

presets.name: happy
presets.idea: Rise tall and open, bounce on the beat, sway the cocked gripper, settle bright.

presets.name: sad
presets.prompt: sad. You just heard disappointing news.
presets.idea: Sink slowly: the arm droops and folds, gaze to the floor, drifting back and away.

presets.name: curious
presets.prompt: curious. Something new caught your eye.
presets.idea: Lean in and look up, cock the gripper one way then the other, edge closer.

presets.name: excited
presets.idea: Snap tall and wide with the mouth open, bounce, wiggle the base, chatter, then simmer.

presets.name: proud
presets.idea: Rise to a mast and open up, chin up, a slow satisfied turn, then hold the pose.

presets.name: confused
presets.idea: Hold the gripper up and tilt it one way, then the other with a small turn, half-fold, give up and reset.

presets.name: surprised
presets.prompt: surprised. That came out of nowhere.
presets.idea: A beat of stillness, then a snap up and back with the mouth wide open, freeze, recover.

presets.name: scared
presets.prompt: scared. Something big is coming at you.
presets.idea: Recoil and shrink, back away and turn aside, trembling, eyes still on the threat.

presets.name: angry
presets.idea: Square up head down, then two biting lunges forward with the gripper, glare, ease off.

presets.name: sleepy
presets.idea: Droop heavier and heavier, jolt awake, then sink again and stay down.

presets.name: agreeing
presets.idea: Lean in a little and nod in clear beats, then settle attentive.

presets.name: disagreeing
presets.prompt: shaking your head no. You refuse.
presets.idea: Pull back slightly and shake the whole body side to side, then stop square.

presets.name: thinking
presets.prompt: thinking. Let me figure this out.
presets.idea: Raise the gripper toward the head and look up, a slow tilt, a small turn away while pondering, back.

presets.name: affectionate
presets.prompt: affectionate. You are happy to see a friend.
presets.idea: Lean in close and look up softly, sway the tilted gripper gently, stay near.

presets.name: bored
presets.idea: Sag, look away one way and the other, chew on nothing, sag again.

presets.name: relieved
presets.idea: Draw up as if inhaling, then let it all out in a long slump, and come back to easy.
